arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Krauss argued the state court added an unwarranted condition to Belton. He asserted the lower court misread the precedent.
Garre argued Belton permits searching a car incident to arrest. He stated the rule applies when an individual is arrested alongside the car.
Dodge argued the facts here differ greatly from Belton. She noted the officer in Belton faced four individuals on a busy Thruway.
